parts: How often should I feed a starter that I keep on the counter?

At room temperature, feed it once a day. Keep 50 g of starter, then add 50 g of flour and 50 g of water. If you move the jar to the fridge, once a week is enough. Feed it twice before baking so it is active again.

title: Two ways to cycle to the station

parts: I can ride to the station along the river path or on the main road. Which should I pick?

The river path is about 4 km and takes 18 minutes. It is quiet, but unlit after dark and muddy after rain. The main road is 3 km and takes 12 minutes, with a painted lane and two busy junctions. Take the river path on dry mornings and the main road when it is dark or wet.
How far apart should I plant tomato seedlings in a raised bed?

Leave 45 to 60 cm between plants and 90 cm between rows. Bush varieties can sit at the closer end. Plant deep, up to the first true leaves, and add a stake at planting time so you do not damage roots later.

title: Packing for a wet weekend walk

parts: What should I pack for two days of walking when rain is forecast?

Pack a waterproof jacket and overtrousers, two pairs of wool socks, a dry bag for spare clothes, a paper map in a zip bag, a head torch, and a flask. Line the rucksack with a bin liner. Leave cotton layers at home because they stay wet.

title: Sharing costs in a three-person flat

parts: Three of us share a flat and the rooms are different sizes. How can we split the bills fairly?

Split rent by room area and split utilities and internet equally. Keep one shared list for groceries and settle it on the first of each month. Agree on a small buffer, such as 20 per person, for cleaning supplies.
